instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Base UI components from @/components/ui (button, input, textarea, dialog, sheet, tabs, dropdown-menu, select, badge, card, popover, sonner) must be heavily styled to match the dark/light Mosaic design aesthetic.
2. For Social icons, use `@icons-pack/react-simple-icons` (SiInstagram, SiTiktok, SiYoutube, SiX, SiGithub, SiDiscord, SiSpotify, SiLinkedin, SiTwitch) with fallback to Lucide glyphs.
3. Public profile (/u/:username) must render seamlessly both standalone and inside the Dashboard's Live Phone Simulator frame.

4. Story Studio must feature direct-link invite and question-answer templates, six selectable visual themes, a face-focused creator portrait, a 9:16 preview/export, copyable profile-link sticker guidance, and client-side PNG export.
5. Anonymous messages must have toggleable owner moderation (publish to Public Q&A wall, reply privately, or create Story graphic).
6. AI Chatbot on profiles must use emergentintegrations /api/ai/chat endpoint with strict prompt grounding on the user profile facts so it answers accurately without hallucinating.
7. Include pre-populated vibrant demo profiles for instant exploration (e.g., /u/maya, /u/liam, /u/alex) with active polls, answered Q&As, and sample anonymous messages.
8. Ensure every button, input, toggle, and link contains an explicit `data-testid` attribute for testing automation.
